about_the_game:
After the surreal charm of The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo, the quirky yellow character returns in Unboxing Mr. Coo; a hand-drawn, wordless journey through a strange world and oddball creatures. Each frame’s drawn by hand, bringing Mr. Coo’s bizarre universe to life in a fresh, animated adventure.

The story

Mr Coo is trying to open a gift box, but soon things get out of hand, and size. He will have to explore the inside of the box, which is anything but square.

Featuring:

  • Rich hand-drawn 2D animation makes Mr. Coo games unique

  • Ingenious, humorous, and out-of-the-box thinking puzzles

  • An innovative story that avoids narrative clichés and overused tropes

  • A vibrant art style, taking players on a journey through mesmerizing, dreamlike scenarios. 

  • Hundreds of notebook pages have been filled with designs which will appear in the game as extra content after the first playthrough

Playtime:

Around 4 hours

About the author:

Nacho Rodríguez has been working in animation since 2002, creating short films, music videos, and video games. In 2023, he released his first commercial game, The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo, which won 16 international awards. He is currently working on Mr. Coo's next adventure: Unboxing Mr. Coo.
